title: Chemical light does not require an external light source
original_forecast: Only the complete prepared formulation plus activator should produce its declared emission state. There is no incoming-light command, separating chemical emission from ordinary illuminated appearance.
original_limitations: The prepared formulation already represents its alkaline catalyst-containing system. It is not a synthesis recipe, a commercial glow stick, or a fully resolved luminol oxidation ledger.

question.original_criterion: Can a prepared chemiluminescent formulation emit after chemical activation without an irradiation command?
question.original_instruction: Only the complete prepared formulation plus activator should produce its declared emission state. There is no incoming-light command, separating chemical emission from ordinary illuminated appearance.
question.assessment: Only complete formulation+activator has a supported emission state; no-activator and no-formulation controls remain negative even though both peroxide arms undergo equal smalldecomposition. Independent state-derived Arrhenius/display decay reproduces both actual samples and persistent scene. AllH/O and retainedO2 close; no incoming-light command, molecular luminol reaction ledger, photon budget or commercial glow-stick claim.
